patient._comment: 'patient' is info about the patient: personal, clinical, vitals are shown on the patient card during the game; diagnosis is used for potential 'patient review' card.

clinical.quoteLong: I was grinding metal without goggles because goggles 'aren't cool.' Breaking news: goggles are extremely cool. My right eye won't open and it's crying without my permission.
clinical.presentationShort: 23yo M — R eye FB sensation after grinding metal, no goggles. Vision intact.
clinical.presentationLong: 23-year-old male, right-eye foreign-body sensation after grinding metal without goggles, vision intact.

diagnosis.disposition: Fast Track → topical anesthetic, fluorescein + slit lamp, remove FB, check for rust ring, antibiotic drops
diagnosis.why: Always evert the lid and rule out globe penetration first. High-speed metal-on-metal is the classic corneal FB — one-resource ESI 4.

answer._comment: 'answer' is answer for the game scoring.

aiImageGeneration._comment: 'aiImageGeneration' is info for AI to generate the image of the patient. Most images were done with openAI gpt-image-1 using an API, not the app, in July 2026. Look for some python scripts that are used to create these images. Be sure that the anchor-image is available and is provided to the AI - otherwise the images will not be consistent.

Match the exact painterly style, brushwork, shading, line weight, lighting, and palette of the attached reference image. Subject: an Asian 23-year-old guy in a dusty work t-shirt, on the same blue clinic chair. Pose: sitting, tilting his head, cupping his right eye. Expression: squinting hard, one eye clamped shut and watering. Clearly visible: right eye squeezed shut, a tear streak down that cheek. Overall uncomfortable but stable. No text, no logos.
